title: Make Gallery presentation state backend-neutral
scope: Expose structured backend-neutral status, help, error and presentation data from the common Gallery session and remove backend-specific and input-device wording from common runtime code.
acceptance: The session reports platform, backend, device, renderer, readback and timing as structured fields; common code does not hardcode a graphics backend or touch, keyboard or controller wording.
Desktop and mobile shells format readable status and help from the same fields and semantic actions, with contract coverage for Vulkan, CUDA, D3D12 and Metal labels.
